landing.subtitle: A world-class competitive mathematics platform. From POSN to IMO — structured curricula, adaptive ratings, and a global community pushing the boundaries of problem solving.
landing.features.subtitle: Built by math olympiad veterans for the next generation of problem solvers.
landing.features.f1.title: Structured Practice
landing.features.f1.desc: Curated problem sets from POSN to IMO level, organized by topic and difficulty rating.
landing.features.f2.title: Adaptive Rating
landing.features.f2.desc: Elo-based rating system that adapts to your skill. Compete and climb the global leaderboard.
landing.features.f3.title: Full Curriculum
landing.features.f3.desc: Complete learning pathways with theory lessons, worked examples, and progressive challenges.
landing.features.f4.title: Live Leaderboard
landing.features.f4.desc: Track your progress against the community. See who dominates each topic and difficulty tier.
landing.cta.title: Ready to Begin?
landing.cta.desc: Join thousands of students and competitors leveling up their mathematical thinking every day.
